title: UI critique (Low): sidebar labels wrap at the 190 px minimum width
description: At the minimum sidebar width (190 px, ProjectSidebar.tsx:177/589) 'Snapshots & history' wraps to two lines (button height 36 px vs 21 px for Comments and Read manuscript, measured) and the 'Personal Word' brand heading wraps too; the entry word count is hidden at that width. Pre-existing (noted in T076's review), not caused by the palette work. Screenshot: docs/agent-work/2026-10-25-ui-polish/screens/browser-writing-sidebar-190-light-plain.png. Suggested: raise the minimum to the width where every fixed label fits on one line, or let these labels ellipsize with a title tooltip. Reference: Ulysses and Bear truncate sidebar labels on one line rather than wrapping.

handoff.text: Regression: the pre-T096 critique capture docs/agent-work/2026-10-25-ui-polish/screens/browser-writing-sidebar-190-light-plain.png (sidebar 190 css px) shows 'Manuscript' (selected, semibold) in full on one line; ui-t96/shots/sidebar-190-{light,dark}.png now show 'Manuscr...'. Also truncated at 190: 'Personal W...' (brand) and 'Snapshots & hi...'; Fragments, Research, Read manuscript, Comments, Settings, 'Reveal sidebar on hover' are full. 270 px shots: nothing truncated. Fix: inside the existing @container (max-width: 240px) block, hide the reserved reorder-button space (or collapse the chevron gap) for group headings so 'Manuscript', 'Fragments', 'Research' render in full at 190 px; keep the ellipsis only as a last resort for longer labels such as 'Snapshots & history'. The new test in tests/sidebar-selection.spec.ts must also assert that those three group headings are not truncated (.group-label scrollWidth <= clientWidth). Rest checked: span.group-label wrapper and container-query rules (nowrap/ellipsis, brand display:block, hover checkbox flex-shrink:0) match the note; data-group/BookMarked are T076; no font-size change in T096 rules; fail-first log shows 'Personal Word is one line' expected 1 got 2; tsc 0 under pinned Node. Browser suite not rerun by reviewer (rejection does not depend on it).

review.note: Cycle 2 OK. Viewed 5 shots-c2: at 190 px Manuscript, Fragments, Research, Read manuscript, Comments, Snapshots & history, Settings, hover-setting all full; only brand ellipsizes (Personal W...). Hovered Manuscript: actions overlay right of the label, touching the final t but no letters covered; chevron visible. CSS inside @container max-width 240px only, tokens only, no font-size change, actions absolute with var(--sidebar) bg, pointer-events none until hover/focus-within; so 270 px unchanged (270 shot shows actions in normal flow with reserved space). Failfirst-c2 log fails on cycle-1 CSS. tsc 0; own rebuild port 1598, 4 specs 27 passed one worker no retries. Minor: the two reorder arrows stay hidden at 190 (pre-existing).
